product_metadata.title: Aluminum Sheet Pans (15 Pack) Disposable Heavy-Duty Large Baking Trays - Half Sheet Size. Sturdy Foil Pans Great For Baking Cookies, Grilling and more, 17 3/4" x 13 1/4" x 1 1/4"
features: EXTRA-STURDY ALUMINUM PANS – Made from quality food-grade aluminum with reinforced rib walls, DOBI pans are stronger and sturdier than most single-use aluminum pans. Deep sides and full curl trim reduce the risk of spills.

VERSATILE – Choose from several multipurpose sizes that can be refrigerated, frozen, and heated in the oven. Perfect for picnics and potlucks, cooking, baking, storing food, and sending guests home with leftovers.
EVEN COOKING AND BAKING – Our special design facilitates air flow for superior heat conductivity. DOBI’s extra-sturdy aluminum promotes even cooking and baking for beautiful and delicious results.
MESS-FREE AND ECO-FRIENDLY – Skip the dirty dishes with DOBI disposable pans, made of infinitely recyclable aluminum and kinder to the environment than single-use plastic.
VALUE PACKAGED – Put convenience within reach with 15 pack sizes at affordable prices, ideal for home cooks, professional chefs, and caterers alike.
